description_zh: 为指定的轻量应用服务器重置系统
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open reset-system --instance-id ace0706b2ac4454d984295a942130000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetSystem

parameters.help_en: The ID of the simple application server
parameters.help_zh: 指定的轻量应用服务器的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查询可用地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination image. If you do not specify this parameter, the current image is reset
parameters.help_zh: 目标镜像ID。如果不输入目标镜像ID，默认为重置当前镜像
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that you want to use to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en: The name of the key pair that you want to bind to the simple application server. Only Linux simple application servers support key pairs
fields.help_zh: 密钥对名称。仅Linux服务器支持设置密钥对
fields.name: key_pair_name

fields.help_en:
The password that corresponds to the administrator.

For Windows servers, the default administrator account is Administrator.

Linux servers, the default administrator account is root
fields.help_zh:
输入轻量应用服务器管理员账号对应的密码。

Windows服务器：管理员账号默认为Administrator。

Linux服务器：管理员账号默认为root
fields.name: password

parameters.help_en: The information about the logon credentials
parameters.name: login_credentials
